behaviors.description: If the reek moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 18 (4d8) kinetic damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

name: Reek, Adult
sectionText: Reeks are large, muscular quadrupeds native to the planet Ylesia. Though naturally herbivores, a starved reek can become a ravenous meat-eater. They sport two large cheek horns that can be used for head-locking in combat with another Reek as a sign of dominance.
